openings.claim: Disconnect only the handoff carrier: compare supplied digests at matching artifact boundaries, pass an unordered equality/inequality multiset without boundary/record IDs, and preserve comparator and ledger functions. The ledger independently catalogs supplied IDs, stages and missing fields; it cannot rematch anonymous results, reread digests to reconstruct comparisons, or infer definite divergence from detached results. Honest unresolved intervals remain possible, with conjectured localization loss.
openings.discriminator: Compared with the nearest rival using boundary-and-record-linked results, expect more unresolved intervals and fewer correct definite stages. Neither variant may reorder stages because of timestamp inversion. Defeat: reconstructed handoff, unsupported definite claim, missing-record nonexecution inference, an interval excluding the revealed boundary, or over twelve manual inspections per pair.
openings.probe: Assign one disjoint three-pair subset per variant; use identical manifest ordering and inspection logs. Report each earliest supported stage or unresolved interval, supplied references and bounded next check. Disconnected outputs may give the manifest-ordered ingest-to-export interval with catalogued references; name a manifest-listed missing boundary record for inspection without executing repair. During final review remove one randomly selected transform record from each of two pairs, leaving manifests unchanged. Freeze outputs before opening two sealed answer sheets; compare supported localization, correctness, interval coverage and inspection counts within twenty additional minutes.
openings.uncertainty: The difference is conjectural, unmeasured; unequal subset difficulty limits causal comparison. Assume the supplied local script can discard labels while retaining both functions and independent records. Feasibility requires automated extraction within sixty analyst minutes; the inspection cap does not establish capacity. If extraction cannot finish, retain unresolved intervals and report resource failure. Affected pairs and sealed-sheet subset coverage are unspecified. Declared fit preserves is contingent on these constraints, not demonstrated feasibility.
